mira_pm: T-minus 50 for the hotfix cutover. PR 8347 is queueing for merge but needs 2 approvals before cutoff. Can someone sherpa approvals? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8347
alex_dev: I'm on PR review now, pushing a tiny comment on the snapshot test. Will approve after CI.
jenna_eng: I can give the second approve after alex. Ping me when CI is green.
sam_sre: CI shows flaky test failure on canary: `test_prefetch_kv_cache` failing intermittently. Trying restart.
deploy-bot: CI/PR 8347 — status: checks pending (workflow/unit-tests), 1 failing job. <https://ci.redwood-inference/tests/8347>
alex_dev: pushed a fix for snapshot; diff is trivial. /cc @jenna_eng also added a note to changelog.
mira_pm: can we get a quick smoke post-merge? Need to ensure latency SLO on small batch workloads. If we miss 2x approvals by T-minus 15 we fallback to rollback plan.
kevin_ops: I'll stand by for the merge and trigger warmup if approved. Also double-checking config for dedicated pool.
sam_sre: retriggered the flaky job, re-run queued.
deploy-bot: CI/PR 8347 — checks passing (workflow/unit-tests) at 4211112260.
jenna_eng: lgtm — second approve. Good callouts in PR description.
alex_dev: lgtm from me too. Ready to merge — can someone with merge rights take it? :raised_hands:
mira_pm: thanks all. @kevin_ops can you do the merge + warmup? If anything odd, roll back and ping `#eng-oncall`.
kevin_ops: merging now. `git merge --no-ff origin/feature/fix-snapshot-8347` then triggering warmup script.
kevin_ops: merged and kicked warmup. Observability dashboard shows kv-cache warmup spikes as expected. Closing thread. :shipit:
